name: Flat bacon
summary: Flat strips of bacon with pink meat and white fat stripes. For breakfast, brunch or diner scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the strips rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~400 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = slight rock, pop = scale in
